_doc: BACKDROPS-2 (docs/geo.md): the backdrop budget, read by tools/geo_bake.py and tools/check_geo.mjs. A map takes the first tier it matches. Maps that are representative or procedural get no real backdrop.

tiers.why: GEO's 21 maps, unchanged: small boxes (2-25 km) where the site detail reads on the parish map
the wide New Orleans parish boxes: a picture of a box this wide shows land, water and towns, not site detail, at either size, so 384 px keeps the read and saves bytes
the 4-14 km city and Bay maps: full size, a lower quality ceiling and a 64 KB cap so 18 maps fit

none.why: a representative or procedural map is not the place in any picture, so a real backdrop would claim what it is not
